text: U.S. Bancorp's only disclosed 5%-plus shareholders are asset managers The Vanguard Group (8.7%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.0%); U.S. Bank National Association is a banking subsidiary of U.S. Bancorp, not its owner. No state shareholder is identified, so the sponsorship money is private capital.

source.name: US BANCORP DEF 14A 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: each person who is known by us to beneficially own more than 5% of our voting securities
